sessionStart.comment: Inject workspace structure, identity, goals, and maintenance signals at session start

postToolUse.comment: Schema enforcement on note writes — NOTE: Copilot ignores postToolUse output; this logs only. For enforcement, use preToolUse.

preToolUse.comment: Schema enforcement via deny — blocks writes to notes/ missing YAML frontmatter. Copilot processes preToolUse deny decisions.

sessionEnd.comment: Persist session state and auto-commit on session end
